results.title: Gujarat Rent Bill 2026 Passed in State Assembly
results.description: Gandhinagar: The Gujarat Legislative Assembly on Friday passed the Gujarat Rent Bill-2026, paving the way for a new legal framework to regulate rental housing and commercial properties across the state. The new law will replace the Bombay Rents, Hotel and Lodging House Rates Control Act, 1947, and seeks to balance the rights and responsibilities of landlords and tenants while making rent-related disputes easier to resolve. results.description: Absconding PG operator Shubham Tyagi, who had surrendered before the Patiala House Court in connection with the Delhi building collapse case, was sent to two days of police custody on Friday.
